title: Faster Whisper Batch Worker
description: Transcribe many audio files in one request with faster-whisper. Model weights are baked into the image for fast cold starts, and CTranslate2 workers plus a thread pool keep the GPU busy across files and concurrent jobs.

input.name: Whisper Model
input.description: faster-whisper model to load. Only 'turbo' is prefetched into the image; any other value is downloaded on the first cold start.

input.name: Compute Type
input.description: CTranslate2 inference precision. float16 is fastest on 24GB+ GPUs; int8_float16 uses less VRAM.

input.name: CTranslate2 Workers
input.description: Parallel CTranslate2 inference workers sharing one set of GPU weights; each adds roughly 0.5-1.5GB of activation VRAM.

input.name: Max Concurrent Jobs
input.description: How many jobs one worker pulls at the same time (RunPod concurrency modifier).

input.name: Transcription Threads
input.description: Thread pool size used to transcribe the files of a single batch request in parallel.

input.name: Audio Download Timeout (seconds)
input.description: Timeout for fetching each audio_url before the job fails.

input.name: Audio Download Threads
input.description: How many audio_urls are fetched at the same time. Downloads run on billed wall-clock while the GPU idles, so serial fetching shows up in the bill.

input.name: Max Audio Size (MB)
input.description: Per-file download ceiling. A file over it fails that slot instead of filling the container disk.

input.name: Allow Private Audio URLs
input.description: By default audio_url hosts resolving to private, loopback or link-local addresses are rejected. Set true only if you fetch audio from inside your own network.
